notes.title: Developer Update: The Future of Motel Life Simulator
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

First, we want to express our sincere gratitude for your continued interest and support for Motel Life Simulator. This project holds a special place in our hearts, and we feel it’s time to provide you with an important update regarding its current status.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982746/98181c4714180060cc378d01645afeff2e2ac8b1.png[/img]
[h1]The Journey So Far[/h1]
We officially announced Motel Life Simulator in December 2022, with great excitement and high ambitions. Over the next six months, we worked hard to shape the game, but as an indie team with limited resources, we encountered some unexpected challenges. Two of our core team members had to leave due to other commitments, and we struggled with securing the necessary funds to continue development at the pace we wanted. As a result, we made the difficult decision to pause development.

While we did share this news with our community on Discord, we decided not to post an official update on Steam at the time. Part of the reason for this was the emergence of several other motel simulator games. Rather than rushing our project to be among the first, we made the choice to step back and regroup, focusing on securing the resources and creative energy to return to Motel Life Simulator with the quality it deserves.

[h2]What We’ve Been Up To[/h2]
In the meantime, we’ve had the exciting opportunity to work on a new project in collaboration with another studio named [b]Ashen Studios[/b]. This has led to the development of [b]Liminalcore[/b], a psychological horror game that has been receiving fantastic feedback from our early playtesters and demo players so far. We are now gearing up for its release on 25 October 2024.

Though this project took our immediate focus, we want to emphasize that Motel Life Simulator is still very much on our minds. We care deeply about this game and the community that’s been built around it.

[b][h3][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3107900/Liminalcore/]LIMINALCORE[/url]
[/h3][/b]
[u][b]Demo of LIMINALCORE is available on Steam if you want to try the game
[/b][/u]

[h2]The Future of Motel Life Simulator[/h2]
After the release of Liminalcore, we plan to revisit and reignite development on Motel Life Simulator. We are more committed than ever to making it a game that stands out—one that’s true to our original vision, with unique mechanics and an enjoyable experience. Rushing a release just to meet a competitive timeline would have resulted in a half-baked product, and that’s not something we’re willing to do.

What’s Next?
We will provide a more detailed update on Motel Life Simulator after the release of Liminalcore. Rest assured, we’re not giving up on the game; we’re just taking the time needed to ensure we do it justice.

Thank you again for your patience and understanding. We are small but we are really passionate and we have so many ideas and stories to share with you in the form of Game Experiences. We look forward to sharing more exciting news with you soon!

Kind regards,
Team of Shadow Owl Studios

notes.title: DevLog 03
notes.notes:
Hey Everybody!

We are back with another DevLog

It's Halloween and we decorated our motel with Halloween vibe and brought a new Dev Log.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982746/44c8ab0d867e8934d54c7f4a23fadb4a7f0b98c4.jpg[/img]

We have hit another milestone in development of the project.
We are working on Motel Exterior Customization system. The size of the motel building is huge so we don't want the player to go to every small piece and change it manually.
For that we have created a customization system that will change allow player to change whole motel design. This system also allows players to change Motel Exterior and interior of every room independently.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982746/c39c49f3931dfcd600e26f3106d5d5d1184e3be2.jpg[/img]

Player can now change motel from the in game computer in Office.
Currently we have 4 motel Exterior Designs.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982746/575db921f2099e34cae8320e6792ec77ae7a7327.jpg[/img]

We are also working on Interiors customization system that we can't wait to share next with you guys.

See you next time
Don't forget to follow, Share and Wishlist!

notes.title: DevLog 02
notes.notes:
Hey Everybody!

We have hit another milestone in development of the project.
We want to share that the work on Diner have started and we already have some amazing props to share with you guys.
A Motel can't be complete with a Diner so customers can get some lite food while they are staying in the Motel. Diner will be one of the most important part of the experience. Player will be able to earn and hire chefs to cook tasty dishes and satisfy the customers cravings.
One of our amazing artist Abdul Basit have been creating some amazing props for the diner including a tasty cake.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982746/fba1943dafc468bca420979e5381c261cd54a45d.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982746/4cba40fd6b3796d0528396c47322374012bb66bf.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982746/df773d081eb6ab5552838d44b2cb4ec1cf6c6edb.jpg[/img]
We have plans for the Motel to be also accessible to the customers who just wanna take a break from there long journey and have some bite. A separate parking area will be available with diner for diner only customers.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982746/76a324b803861daffa8ac8c96175d56a4fc05fd4.png[/img]

We are working on some interior fixes and soon we will share the interior of the diner and how it will work.
Do visit and have a bit from our tasty menu.

See you next time
Share and wishlist

notes.title: DevLog 01
notes.notes:
DevLog 01

We are almost done with the furniture designs as we have received some great furniture props from our amazing artist Najam. He have done an amazing job in designing some unique looking furniture for the motel rooms.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982746/fd4018651822c4c87aa83ac2cafb8da1c919f6a7.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982746/99df9f928bfc02fdce6e96d2bd33d38520284833.jpg[/img]
 Every room will have it's unique ambience with textured walls and furniture. We have plans to design customization system so that player will be able to place furniture to his own liking in every room. 
Player will be able to order furniture and then place these to his own liking in every room.
Player will be able to select from many different bed and sofa designs and have these delivered to his warehouse.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982746/a69642b5900b53e23ae110758c949ddea6c9ce49.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982746/ee2577f68d5a0518776655e753140224690c01da.jpg[/img]
Other then new furniture there will be some old and broken furniture that will be scattered around motel rooms that player have to clean at start. small and large pieces like broken wood pieces of bed and a mattress or broken chairs.

We have alot of content planned that we can't wait to share with you all.
Stay Tuned and don't forget to wishlist and share with your friends because who knows that it will become a co-op adventure.
